title: The Fratricide Contract
logline: An underworld hitman bound by clan law to execute their sibling uncovers evidence that the syndicate underboss secretly authorized the prohibited smuggling run to purge rivals.

roles.description: A loyal underworld executioner bound by an ancient blood oath; agonizing over the contract on their younger brother.
A reckless courier who poached cargo from a prohibited lane; swears he was framed by the family leadership.
An austere syndicate elder who insists that code infractions must be washed in family blood to prevent civil war.
A nimble interceptor skiff sent by the underboss to locate the safehouse and burn down witnesses.
A matte-black heavy interdictor armed with concussion torpedo tubes and armored cockpit shields.
A hidden pressurized airlock hidden behind an abandoned ore processing hopper.
A century-old criminal fraternity that governs station black markets through strict blood oaths.

public_situation: Rumors of an impending underworld purge circulate through the lower docks of {system} as rival smugglers clear out of the outer ring.
private_truth: The syndicate underboss secretly authorized the prohibited smuggling run using a forged seal, deliberately entrapping the younger brother to force a loyal enforcer to prove unconditional obedience.

beats.public_change: Syndicate lookouts take up surveillance positions along docking alleyways while fuel deliveries to the outer ring are curtailed.

missions.reason: He hires an outsider pilot to retrieve his brother's navigation datapad from the safehouse before syndicate cleaners sweep the berth.
missions.private_fact: He wants proof of who issued the flight orders before he is forced by clan law to carry out the death warrant.

beats.public_change: Syndicate gunboats begin patrolling the station perimeter with orders to shoot down any craft leaving without an underboss transponder.

missions.reason: He begs the pilot to scan the datapad's cryptographic header against the syndicate dispatch relay to verify the underboss's digital signet.
missions.private_fact: He knows that if the underboss's seal is verified, the entire family code will turn against the leadership for manufacturing a false contract.

beats.public_change: The underboss deploys an interceptor to eliminate the safehouse airlock and incinerate all physical evidence.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to destroy the trailing syndicate hit-ship before it can breach the safehouse and kill his brother.
missions.private_fact: Taking arms against a syndicate ship technically marks him as a code-breaker, forfeiting his rank and protection.

beats.public_change: The syndicate underboss arrives in person at the central docking gantry, demanding the enforcer present his brother's corpse.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to escort his escape shuttle through the outer gate cordon before the underboss seals the jump perimeter.
missions.private_fact: The underboss hails mid-flight offering the pilot a lucrative syndicate smuggling franchise if they disable the brother's engines and stand down.

player_choice.prompt: With the brother alive and proof of the frame-up in hand, the pilot must decide how to resolve the family blood feud.

options.label: Present the underboss's forged seal to the clan elders to trigger an internal coup
Help both brothers escape the system together into deep space
Deliver the brother to the underboss to uphold the criminal code

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot presents the cryptographic evidence of the frame-up to syndicate elders.
resolutions.summary: The elders declare {role:syndicate_underboss} an oath-breaker for fabricating contracts. The underboss is deposed while {role:syndicate_enforcer} assumes command of the family.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot exposed an underworld boss who framed his own men, sparking a dockside gang coup.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot escorts both brothers past the outer gate cordon.
resolutions.summary: {role:syndicate_enforcer} and {role:errant_brother} escape together into outer space, severing their blood ties forever. {role:syndicate_underboss} tightens his grip on the station docks.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped two underworld brothers break a syndicate hit cordon and flee into exile.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the underboss's bribe or delivers the brother to the dock.
resolutions.summary: {role:errant_brother} is executed on the docks to satisfy the syndicate code. {role:syndicate_enforcer} remains trapped in service, broken by grief and guilt.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot delivered a renegade smuggler to gang executioners to satisfy an underworld debt.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never gets involved or abandons the brother.
resolutions.summary: {role:syndicate_enforcer} refuses to execute his brother but fails to save him, fleeing into outer darkness while {role:syndicate_underboss} cleanses the docks.

loose_threads.detail: The datapad includes an encrypted access voucher for a private security deposit box rented under an assumed name.
The torpedoes loaded onto the interceptor carry lot numbers traced to an impounded cargo vessel auctioned by port customs.

radio_hooks: Underworld tensions flare across outer maintenance rings of {system}.
Dock security reports unconfirmed weapons fire in cargo transit corridor four.
Independent haulers advised to avoid unpatrolled berths following gang dispute.

voice_direction.syndicate_enforcer: Heavy, low, and speaks in terse deliberate sentences. Sounds profoundly weary and pauses as if physically carrying weight.
voice_direction.errant_brother: Youthful, defiant, and speaks with frantic bravado that cracks under pressure. Desperately wants his brother's approval.
voice_direction.syndicate_underboss: Smooth, grandfatherly, and chillingly affectionate. Uses terms of family endearment while giving ruthless execution orders.
